answer: Stable with a repeated pole at -2
author: Hermes
options: Stable with a repeated pole at -2
question: A system has characteristic equation s^2 + 4s + 4 = 0. What can be said about its poles and stability?
solution: s^2 + 4s + 4 = (s + 2)^2, so there is a repeated pole at s = -2. Both poles lie in the left half-plane, so the system is stable. Topic (stability, poles) is in the Control Systems section of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
